The main takeaway from our work is that
the label space of an XMC task can be more accurately modeled by flexible and overlapped clusters than by mutually-exclusive ones.
the label clustering problem can be formulated as a precision-maximization problem, and the solution can be used to guide the model learning process in partition-based XMLC.
